parameters.query: SELECT * FROM (SELECT DISTINCT u.n8n_user_id as user_id, s.id as source_id, s.url as source_url, s.name as source_name, s.scout_id, sc.priorities_markdown as priorities, COALESCE(u.settings->>'timezone', 'Europe/Amsterdam') as timezone FROM radar_sources s JOIN radar_scouts sc ON sc.id = s.scout_id JOIN portal_user u ON u.n8n_user_id = s.user_id WHERE s.status = 'followed' AND sc.status = 'active' AND sc.priorities_markdown <> '') t ORDER BY random() LIMIT 50

UPDATE radar_sources SET notes = jsonb_set(
  (CASE WHEN notes IS NOT NULL AND left(ltrim(notes),1) = '{' THEN notes::jsonb ELSE '{}'::jsonb END),
  '{health}',
  jsonb_build_object(
    'status', 'failed',
    'last_sweep', to_char(NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"'),
    'consecutive_failures', COALESCE(((CASE WHEN notes IS NOT NULL AND left(ltrim(notes),1) = '{' THEN notes::jsonb ELSE '{}'::jsonb END) #>> '{health,consecutive_failures}')::int, 0) + 1,
    'reason', '{{ $json.fail_reason }}',
    'recent', (SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(r.v ORDER BY r.i), '[]'::jsonb) FROM (SELECT t.v, t.i FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE((CASE WHEN notes IS NOT NULL AND left(ltrim(notes),1) = '{' THEN notes::jsonb ELSE '{}'::jsonb END) #> '{health,recent}', '[]'::jsonb)) WITH ORDINALITY AS t(v, i) ORDER BY t.i DESC LIMIT 9) r) || '["fail"]'::jsonb
  )
)::text, updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = '{{ $json.source_id }}'::uuid

  )
)::text, updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = '{{ $('Parse Articles').first().json.source_id }}'::uuid
